Seroquel XL  Cannabis Bad Exp
I took seroquel xl & cannabis. I was a heavy weed smoker smoked weed for years then started on seroquel. I was on 400mg of seroquel xl at the time it was my normal medication that I had not been taking for ages but decided I was going start.
So I went out for a meal with my family and friend after dinner we went and picked up some strong green. We then went and smoked some. I had 1 really packed bong then we got in the car to drive. Within 5 mins I felt like I was just a voice no body not like normal stoned not being able to move I felt like my voice had power and that all I was was a voice.
8 mins after smoking we got to the petrol station. By this time I felt like I couldn't breathe so I opened the car door and got out and then was took down to my knees. I thought I was dying I remember tell my friend get help. I then blacked out and while blacked out I felt like all time was gone. I was being pulled into the ground deep the more I fought it the more I opened my eyes and got up but the harder it was to stay up. It was the feeling of being pulled down and numb. I remember grabbing my friend that was half my weight and what I thought I was doing was asking him for help what I was doing was trying to push him and grab his throat.
I'm 200lbs my friend is half my weight he was able to put me onto the ground without any trouble. I then got up again fell again nearly hitting my head on a stone pot. I never even stone pot. I then sat up when there was 10 people round me asking is he ok I remember saying its ok mate I'm tripping balls. I then accepted the fact I couldn't do anything at the stage I gave up. I felt like I was suddenly yanked from the back hitting all metal bars on the way back. What I really done was got up and run across the carpark I then felt like I needed to jump. So I tried to jump back into reality I ran against metal cages and fence that also had a 50 foot drop into a river. At that moment I fell onto my back I remember just laying there on the cold wet ground thinking I'm dying. I remember car lights out the side of my eye it was my friend car. When I gave up and fully gave up I came back round when my friend got out to help me I just kept saying ok it helped me come back round.
